page.layout: One page of text, single column. Heading "ADDENDA." centred at top; running text below in paragraphs; a woodcut ornament in the lower middle; catchword-like word "LIBER" in spaced capitals at lower right, set as a division heading.

main_text.head: ADDENDA.
main_text.p: PAg. 76. l. 14. post instituerunt, hęc addantur : In Scepticos quoque aliquid videtur molitus fuisse Caspar Barlæus, si fidem habemus τῶ πἀνυ Dn. Vossio lib 1. de arte Grammat. cap. 3. sed quod hactenus lucem non aspexit. Exarmare quoque eosdem laboravit Thomas Campanella lib. 1. Metaph. sed, uti omnes censent, nimis generaliter, atque suo more confuse.
main_text.head: LIBER

page.notes: The ornament (woodcut) in the lower middle is not text. The Greek phrase "τῶ πἀνυ" is as printed in the scan and may be imperfect. The word "confuse" with a terminal flourish is read as printed. The final word of the heading "LIBER" is followed by a large letter R whose form is partly cut off at the edge of the page.
